routes.name: Companion optimal metric and common boundary density

C9000325.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 325 (The complete Crouzeix conjecture.; papers: A direct proof of the complete Crouzeix inequality; The complete Crouzeix theorem: optimal similarity and a common positive boundary representation; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/325.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

V_DIRECT_CORE.statement: Parameter-uniform implication from ordered coefficient tests and positive convergent Fourier compression to gamma <= 2; derive weighted duality and the block estimate rather than assume them.

V_PAIRING.statement: Tensor evaluation pairs M[k] and C[k] bilinearly entry by entry in the stated orientation, including k=0.

V_ORDERED_TESTS.statement: Both FG and GF preserve their multiplication order; singular pair identities and the coefficient sandwich imply diagonal functional bounds.

V_WEIGHTED_DUAL.statement: Conjugate reciprocal-weight finite coefficient tests yield the diagonal dual energy bounds, including the constant term.

V_POSITIVE_BLOCK.statement: For every finite complex positive block [U Z*; Z V], 2||Z||_HS^2 <= ||U||_HS^2+||V||_HS^2.

V_FOURIER_TAIL.statement: Untruncated Fourier identities and monotone or convergent finite-test limits retain the constant and every tail coefficient.

D_MAIN.statement: Direct thm:main: complete sharp constant-two inequality for every n,m,A and matrix polynomial.

D_DOMAIN.statement: Direct thm:domain: contractive boundary polynomial has evaluation norm at most two on every admissible analytic convex domain.

D_COLLAR.statement: lem:exterior-collar: an injective exterior conformal collar exists with the outward supporting normal.

D_FABER.statement: lem:faber and prop:coefficients: a positive doubly normalized mixed exterior kernel gives the unweighted coefficient sandwich with weights 1 and 2, without symmetry.

D_RESOLVENT.statement: lem:resolvent: positive double-layer field and absolutely geometrically convergent resolvent coefficients.

D_APPROX.statement: lem:approx and Toeplitz-Hausdorff argument: shrink analytic convex neighborhoods to any numerical range, including points and segments.

D_SHARPNESS.statement: The 2-by-2 nilpotent with entry 2 and F(z)=z forces the universal constant to be at least two.

S_STRUCTURAL.statement: Companion thm:structural: the optimal metric is attained and has similarity condition number <=2.

S_REPRESENTATION.statement: Companion thm:representation: one normalized continuous positive density represents every analytic matrix coefficient level after the same optimal similarity.

S_COORDINATES.statement: lem:conformal-coordinates: compatible interior and exterior maps extend across the boundary.

S_METRIC.statement: The strictly feasible metric SDP attains its minimum; metric and similarity optima agree.

S_EXTREMAL.statement: prop:extremal: endpoint vectors and a contractive analytic extremizer satisfy the module endpoint relations.

S_ANALYTIC.statement: input:analytic: positive exterior mixed kernel, unit marginals, and positive convergent original resolvent expansion.

S_PROJECTION.statement: prop:projection: weighted projection estimates, adjoint and module identities, and the resolvent contraction identity.

S_COMPARISON.statement: lem:comparison: positive amplified density and endpoint/module estimates imply kappa<=2.

S_DENSITY.statement: prop:density: Poisson resolvent of a strict spectral-radius contraction gives a normalized positive density representing all analytic matrix tests.
